answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow grants weight only after proven work: each identity locks 50 credits and earns a fingerprint from ten tasks with distinct counterparties. Each task emits a pulse, bound to one key in a basalt seal auditors recheck. A yarrow audit samples the seal; a mismatch freezes the escrow and burns half. The k-th fake needs its own trail, costing 20 credits in fees plus 50 locked, so 1,000 fakes sink 20,000 and lock 50,000. Rented history fails because a bought trail is signed under another key. An honest agent locks 50 once and recovers it at maturity.
